scope: Explicit LMX runtime acceptance requirements for current core reuse and generic source; not an execution report.

cases.input: empty dense int[]
cases.expected: fresh int[] with length zero; comparator is not called

cases.input: singleton @[] containing a structure reference
cases.expected: fresh outer array, same element reference, no comparator call

cases.input: records with equal priority and distinct width/id fields
cases.expected: stable ordering, every field preserved, source slots unchanged

cases.input: char[] and an ordering comparator over char
cases.expected: fresh char[] preserving the complete character profile

cases.input: comparator throws after its second comparison
cases.expected: FxCallFailure retains declared name/payload; source is unchanged; no result publication

cases.input: comparator returns a non-int record
cases.expected: SequenceElement; source unchanged

cases.input: length near admitted profile maximum
cases.expected: no width/end addition before safe difference check; no fixed word-width constants

cases.input: empty array and singleton reference array
cases.expected: fresh same-profile array; same is not called

cases.input: different records equal under user-supplied same
cases.expected: first original record reference retained; output group order stable

cases.input: same throws on a later candidate
cases.expected: FxCallFailure; input unchanged and no partial result

cases.input: same returns non-int
cases.expected: FxPredicate

cases.input: initialized, uninitialized and void records with a callback comparing explicit type codes only
cases.expected: values remain whole typed records; there is no mandatory numeric payload read in unique

cases.input: post owning method that performs sort/unique/bracket
cases.expected: whole operation remains inside owning Message arena; ordinary completion/failure delivered; no shared mutable pointer across arenas

cases.input: Call the same Below method through any then all; threshold changes from 0 to 10 in one Example activation.
cases.expected: Observe separate short-circuit traversals with the current threshold; no saved factory scope and no duplicated predicate body.

cases.input: Group integer codes including 0, then map Frequency over actual FxGroup records.
cases.expected: Keep the direct compound result reference; output key/count pairs preserve integer zero without an extra @ box.

cases.input: Group records containing kind, width and a nested mutable reference, then map GroupRow.
cases.expected: Keep every original record and nested reference; change only the outer group-observation shape.

cases.input: collect eachMatch over empty/nonempty ASCII text, then map matchedText.
cases.expected: Stop terminates only the producer; direct Match and char[] results are retained as complete records with valid arena lifetime.

cases.input: Create two counters via merge with initial values 10 and 100; caller also has a variable value=999.
cases.expected: The explicit copied owner contains the supplied value; independent calls yield [11,14,102,12], with no mutation of caller or original model.

cases.input: Create two copied Squares sources with different limits, consume their next methods through collect, retain arrays after completion.
cases.expected: Zero is kept; source state and limit are independent, records outlive the completed call within the owning Message, no finished stack activation is captured.

cases.input: Invoke Example run for modes 0/1/2 using the shared eval/code helpers; compare complete generic and local approaches.
cases.expected: Results [50,123], [0,123], [0,1]; acquire failure skips release, action failure still releases once; named end cutters retain their ordinary grammar meaning.
